group.label: Türkiye: e-Fatura / e-Arşiv (Nilvera)
group.comment: Beta. Needs your own contract with Nilvera (GİB private integrator). Buyers registered in GİB's e-Fatura list get an e-Fatura, all others an e-Arşiv invoice.

field.label: Environment
field.comment: Test: Nilvera's test system, invoices are not reported to GİB. Live: legally binding invoices. The API key must belong to the same environment. Default: Test.

field.label: Where to find it:
field.comment: create the API key in the Nilvera portal; for Test, use a key from Nilvera's test portal.

field.label: e-Arşiv Series
field.comment: 3 capital letters or digits, e.g. EAR. The series must exist and be active in your Nilvera account (e-Arşiv > Series): Nilvera gives each invoice the next GİB number of this series, e.g. EAR2026000000001. Empty: the default e-Arşiv series of your Nilvera account.

field.label: e-Fatura Series
field.comment: 3 capital letters or digits, e.g. EFT. Must exist and be active in your Nilvera account (e-Fatura > Series). Empty: the default e-Fatura series of your Nilvera account.

field.label: e-Fatura Profile
field.comment: TICARIFATURA lets the buyer accept or reject the invoice in GİB; TEMELFATURA does not. Return invoices and invoices to public administrations are always TEMELFATURA (GİB rule). Default: TICARIFATURA.

group.label: Internet Sales
group.comment: GİB requires on invoices of online sales (VUK General Communiqué 509, IV.2.4.5): the web address, payment method and date, the carrier (name and VKN/TCKN) and the shipment date, plus the sentence "Bu satış internet üzerinden yapılmıştır.". An invoice created before the order is shipped waits: it is generated again automatically when you create the shipment.

field.label: This Store Sells Online
field.comment: Adds the internet sale details to e-Arşiv and e-Fatura sales invoices. GİB also asks for a separate e-Arşiv series for internet sales: set the e-Arşiv Series above. Default: Yes.

field.label: Web Address
field.comment: Web address of the shop where the sale was made, e.g. https://www.example.com.tr. Empty: the store's base URL.

field.label: Payment Types
field.comment: Only needed for methods not covered by the defaults: bank transfer and check / money order = EFT/HAVALE, cash on delivery = KAPIDAODEME, PayPal = ODEMEARACISI, card gateways (Braintree, Stripe, iyzico, PayTR, Adyen) = KREDIKARTI/BANKAKARTI, all others = DIGER with the method's name. Payment intermediary: the payment platform that collects the money (e.g. iyzico), optional. The payment date is the date of the paid Magento invoice.

field.label: Carriers
field.comment: First column: a Magento carrier code (e.g. flatrate, tablerate, ups) or a word of the tracking title or shipping method name (e.g. yurtici, aras); * = all other shipments, e.g. your own delivery with your company name and VKN. Enter each carrier's VKN as printed on its invoices to you: the module does not ship VKNs. Virtual and downloadable orders need no carrier.

group.label: Return Invoices (Credit Memos)
group.comment: What happens with a credit memo. A credit memo that is not sent shows as "Not sent (documented outside)" in Sales > E-Invoices, where you record the number and date of the document that replaces it. Please confirm the setting with your accountant.

field.label: e-Fatura Buyers
field.comment: Issued by the buyer: under GİB's UBL-TR rules a return invoice (IADE) is issued by the buyer who returns the goods; the store sends nothing and records the buyer's invoice. A commercial invoice (TICARIFATURA) can also be rejected by the buyer within 8 days. Issued by the store: the module sends a return invoice (IADE, TEMELFATURA) to the buyer, as before 2.3.0. Default: Issued by the buyer.

field.label: e-Arşiv Buyers (Consumers)
field.comment: Consumers cannot issue invoices. For internet sales the consumer fills in and signs the return section of the e-Arşiv invoice and sends it with the goods: it replaces the expense voucher (gider pusulası) (VUK 509, IV.2.4.5); otherwise you issue an expense voucher (or an e-Gider Pusulası through your integrator). Business buyers outside e-Fatura issue their own return invoice. e-Arşiv return invoice issued by the store: the module sends an e-Arşiv invoice of type IADE, as before 2.3.0. Default: No return invoice.
